weibull_probability.description: Weibull PDF f(v; k=2, c=7). At k=2 this is a Rayleigh distribution. Peak ≈ c·(k-1)^(1/k) = 7·1 = 7 m/s. The integral from 0 to ∞ equals 1.0 (verified separately).

jensen_wake_deficit.description: Jensen/PARK single-wake centreline deficit. The deficit factor at distance d is 1 - (1 - sqrt(1 - Ct)) * (D / (D + 2·k·d))². Values were generated by tpt-nrg-wind; they should be stable to the algorithm's precision.
